   "id": "e30d675e-92a6-4b24-836b-afe24c9fbf87",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Beam Sweeping with Antenna Panels and Arrays"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "c8c96d55-aeb5-4579-9b21-64d4b0d00996",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import matplotlib.animation as animation\n",
    "from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display\n",
    "\n",
    "from neoradium import AntennaElement, AntennaPanel, AntennaArray"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "852cd034-e0fe-422c-b9ab-7ecf7f0a1c23",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## A Linear Antenna Panel with Dual Polarization"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "be1c2337-4702-4ac1-a8d2-1bc3b09eb6b4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Number of ports: 8\n",
      "8 Beams:\n",
      "  Beam    Theta     Phi     Pol\n",
      "  ----    -----    -----    ---\n",
      "   0      90.0     -60.0     x\n",
      "   1      90.0     -38.2     x\n",
      "   2      90.0     -21.8     x\n",
      "   3      90.0      -7.1     x\n",
      "   4      90.0       7.1     x\n",
      "   5      90.0      21.8     x\n",
      "   6      90.0      38.2     x\n",
      "   7      90.0      60.0     x\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Create a linear antenna panel with 8 elements (4 antenna positions with dual polarization)\n",
    "txAntenna=AntennaPanel([1,4], polarization='x')\n",
    "# Get beam sweeping information:\n",
    "weights, beams = txAntenna.getSweepingBeams(numTheta=1, numPhi=8, polStrategy=\"equal\")\n",
    "# 'weights' is a 'numPorts × numBeams' complex matrix.\n",
    "numPorts, numBeams = weights.shape\n",
    "print(f\"Number of ports: {numPorts}\")\n",
    "print(f\"{len(beams[0])} Beams:\")\n",
    "print(\"  Beam    Theta     Phi     Pol\")\n",
    "print(\"  ----    -----    -----    ---\")\n",
    "for i in range(numBeams):\n",
    "    print(f\"   {i}     {np.round(beams[0][i],1):5.1f}     {np.round(beams[1][i],1):5.1f}     {beams[2][i]}\")\n",
    "   "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "cc2c8b86-e41f-4552-b286-7f17a54caeee",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/markdown": [
       "![demo](BeamSweep.gif)"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "<IPython.core.display.Markdown object>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Draw beams (animation):\n",
    "# Note: The ±60° beams are attenuated due to the element pattern (based on 38.901).\n",
    "# To verify, try larger beamwidths or use an omnidirectional element.\n",
    "# Also observe the power of different beams: they become weaker toward the extreme angles (-60° and +60°).\n",
    "#\n",
    "# A panel for a sector works best between -45° and +45°. UEs at the sector edges experience\n",
    "# attenuated beams, which is consistent with practical deployments.\n",
    "#\n",
    "# Options to better cover the full 360°:\n",
    "#   - Use multiple panels per sector\n",
    "#   - Use 4 panels with 90° offsets (common in small cells, dense urban deployments, and FR2)\n",
    "\n",
    "title = \"Horizontal Cut of Radiation Power at zero elevation\\nBeam %d, Beam Azimuth:%.2f°\"\n",
    "# Initial call to get a figure and axis for the animation:\n",
    "ax = txAntenna.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, weights=weights[:,0],\n",
    "                             title = title%(0,beams[1][0]))\n",
    "# Callback function to update the radiation pattern:\n",
    "def updateCb(frame):\n",
    "    ax.clear()\n",
    "    i = frame % numBeams\n",
    "    txAntenna.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, weights=weights[:,i], \n",
    "                            title = title%(i,beams[1][i]), ax=ax)\n",
    "    return ()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create animation of beams:\n",
    "fig = ax.get_figure()\n",
    "anim = animation.FuncAnimation(fig, updateCb, frames = numBeams,  interval=1000, blit=False, repeat=False)\n",
    "plt.close(fig)   # Prevent duplicate static plot\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save the animation to a GIF file and show it below\n",
    "anim.save(\"BeamSweep.gif\", writer=animation.PillowWriter(fps=1))\n",
    "display(Markdown(\"![demo](BeamSweep.gif)\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Another option is to use the following command, which gives you more control over\n",
    "# running and pausing the animation.\n",
    "# HTML(anim.to_jshtml())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fd75fb1d-2ae7-4224-aa46-14f40471f2e9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## A 4×4 Antenna Panel with Dual Polarization"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "7c5f533e-2005-4bd1-b260-0b8843e14d7a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Number of ports: 32\n",
      "16 Beams:\n",
      "  Beam    Theta     Phi     Pol\n",
      "  ----    -----    -----    ---\n",
      "   0      70.0     -60.0     x\n",
      "   1      70.0     -16.8     x\n",
      "   2      70.0      16.8     x\n",
      "   3      70.0      60.0     x\n",
      "   4      83.5     -60.0     x\n",
      "   5      83.5     -16.8     x\n",
      "   6      83.5      16.8     x\n",
      "   7      83.5      60.0     x\n",
      "   8      96.5     -60.0     x\n",
      "   9      96.5     -16.8     x\n",
      "  10      96.5      16.8     x\n",
      "  11      96.5      60.0     x\n",
      "  12     110.0     -60.0     x\n",
      "  13     110.0     -16.8     x\n",

     ]

   ],
   "source": [
    "# Create an antenna panel with 32 elements (16 antenna positions with dual polarization)\n",
    "txAntenna=AntennaPanel([4,4], polarization='x')\n",
    "# Get beam sweeping information:\n",
    "weights, beams = txAntenna.getSweepingBeams(numTheta=4, numPhi=4, thetaSpan=40, polStrategy=\"equal\")\n",
    "# 'weights' is a 'numPorts × numBeams' complex matrix.\n",
    "numPorts, numBeams = weights.shape\n",
    "print(f\"Number of ports: {numPorts}\")\n",
    "print(f\"{len(beams[0])} Beams:\")\n",
    "print(\"  Beam    Theta     Phi     Pol\")\n",
    "print(\"  ----    -----    -----    ---\")\n",
    "for i in range(numBeams):\n",
    "    print(f\"  {i:2d}     {np.round(beams[0][i],1):5.1f}     {np.round(beams[1][i],1):5.1f}     {beams[2][i]}\")\n",
    "   "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "69f0ebe8-d0de-4bab-a040-f9dff3375b97",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Preparing the animation:\n",
      "  Done.                                                  \n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "text/markdown": [
       "![demo3d](BeamSweep3D.gif)"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "<IPython.core.display.Markdown object>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Initial call to obtain the figure and axis for the animation:\n",
    "title = \"Radiation Power for Beam %d\\n$\\\\theta$=%.2f°, $\\\\phi$=%.2f°\"\n",
    "ax = txAntenna.drawRadiation(radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=True, viewAngles=(10,3),\n",
    "                             weights=weights[:,0], \n",
    "                             title = title%(0,beams[0][0],beams[1][0]))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Callback function to update the radiation pattern:\n",
    "def updateCb(frame):\n",
    "    ax.clear()\n",
    "    i = frame % numBeams\n",
    "    print(f\"\\r  Now drawing beam {i} ...\", end=\"\")\n",
    "    txAntenna.drawRadiation(radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=True, viewAngles=(10,3),\n",
    "                            weights=weights[:,i], \n",
    "                            title = title%(i,beams[0][i],beams[1][i]), ax=ax)\n",
    "    ax.set_xlim(-1.5,1.5)\n",
    "    ax.set_ylim(-1.5,1.5)\n",
    "    ax.set_zlim(-1.5,1.5)\n",
    "    if i==numBeams-1: print(\"\\r  Done.\" + 50*\" \")\n",
    "    return ()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create animation of beams:\n",
    "print(\"Preparing the animation:\")\n",
    "fig = ax.get_figure()\n",
    "anim = animation.FuncAnimation(fig, updateCb, frames = numBeams,  interval=1000, blit=False, repeat=True)\n",
    "plt.close(fig)      # Prevent duplicate static plot\n",
    "\n",
    "# Save the animation to a GIF file and show it below\n",
    "anim.save(\"BeamSweep3D.gif\", writer=animation.PillowWriter(fps=1))\n",
    "display(Markdown(\"![demo3d](BeamSweep3D.gif)\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Another option is to use the following command, which gives you more control over\n",
    "# running and pausing the animation.\n",
    "# HTML(anim.to_jshtml())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fd7a5025-ad4e-496e-a327-e706841c6153",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## A Linear Antenna Array"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "777bf9e3-0a50-47e9-ba44-402c5661014d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Number of ports: 8\n",
      "weights shape:   (8, 8)\n",
      "8 Beams:\n",
      "  Beam    Theta     Phi     Pol\n",
      "  ----    -----    -----    ---\n",
      "   0      90.0     -60.0     x\n",
      "   1      90.0     -38.2     x\n",
      "   2      90.0     -21.8     x\n",
      "   3      90.0      -7.1     x\n",
      "   4      90.0       7.1     x\n",
      "   5      90.0      21.8     x\n",
      "   6      90.0      38.2     x\n",
      "   7      90.0      60.0     x\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Now we create a 1×4 antenna array with four 2×2 panels. In this case, we have 8 antenna ports,\n",
    "# and each port corresponds to one panel/polarization (e.g., 4 panels, 2 polarizations).\n",
    "panelTemplate = AntennaPanel([2,2], polarization=\"x\")\n",
    "txArray = AntennaArray([1,4], panels=panelTemplate)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Creating beam sweeping steering vectors for this array:\n",
    "weights, beams = txArray.getSweepingBeams(numTheta=1, numPhi=8, polStrategy=\"equal\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 'weights' is a 'numPorts × numBeams' complex matrix.\n",
    "numPorts, numBeams = weights.shape\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Number of ports: {numPorts}\")\n",
    "print(f\"weights shape:   {weights.shape}\")\n",
    "print(f\"{len(beams[0])} Beams:\")\n",
    "print(\"  Beam    Theta     Phi     Pol\")\n",
    "print(\"  ----    -----    -----    ---\")\n",
    "for i in range(numBeams):\n",
    "    print(f\"   {i}     {np.round(beams[0][i],1):5.1f}     {np.round(beams[1][i],1):5.1f}     {beams[2][i]}\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "9b2365a4-1627-438c-b7d0-586a0ad47113",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<PolarAxes: title={'center': '$\\\\phi=40$'}>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {

      ]

    {

      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Important note:\n",
    "# This antenna array, with default internal precoders (B), behaves like a panel of 4 elements\n",
    "# with 1λ spacing instead of 0.5λ. Since the spacing is larger than 0.5λ, grating lobes appear\n",
    "# for some steering angles. This means we cannot reliably create beams at angles greater than 30°.\n",
    "\n",
    "# Draw the antenna array:\n",
    "txArray.showElements()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Here is how two different beams look when using port-based precoding:\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, layout='constrained', subplot_kw={'projection': 'polar'})\n",
    "txArray.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=10$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txArray.b @ txArray.getPortSteeringVector(90,10).flatten(), ax=ax[0])\n",
    "txArray.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=40$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txArray.b @ txArray.getPortSteeringVector(90,40).flatten(), ax=ax[1])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "290cead8-3b1e-4bdb-a420-05eb3e7b9ece",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [

      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"

    {

    {

     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# To verify this, we can create a panel with 1λ spacing:\n",
    "txPanel=AntennaPanel([1,4], polarization='x', spacing=(1,1))\n",
    "txPanel.showElements(title=\"Equivalent Panel\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Show the same two beams with this panel. As you can see the beams look very similar.\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, layout='constrained', subplot_kw={'projection': 'polar'})\n",
    "txPanel.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=10$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txPanel.getPortSteeringVector(90,10).flatten(), ax=ax[0])\n",
    "txPanel.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=40$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txPanel.getPortSteeringVector(90,40).flatten(), ax=ax[1])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "a81a9468-d3c2-4bf0-9cb5-7c47fd34708c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<PolarAxes: title={'center': '$\\\\phi=40$'}>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,

    {

   ],
   "source": [
    "# One way to address this problem is to reduce the antenna spacing within each panel. \n",
    "# For example, we use antenna panels with an internal spacing of 0.25λ. In this \n",
    "# configuration, the panel centers are separated by 0.5λ, enabling the array to \n",
    "# perform beamforming over larger angles.\n",
    "panelTemplate = AntennaPanel([2,2], spacing=[0.25,0.25], polarization=\"x\")\n",
    "txArray = AntennaArray([1,4], panels=panelTemplate)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Draw the antenna array:\n",
    "txArray.showElements()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Here is how two different beams look when using port-based precoding:\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, layout='constrained', subplot_kw={'projection': 'polar'})\n",
    "txArray.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=10$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txArray.b @ txArray.getPortSteeringVector(90,10).flatten(), ax=ax[0])\n",
    "txArray.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=40$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txArray.b @ txArray.getPortSteeringVector(90,40).flatten(), ax=ax[1])\n",
    "                      "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "9007ab90-e6a0-4cc8-be63-3b5a813c002f",
   "metadata": {},

   ],
   "source": [
    "# Another option is to use element-based precoding, which enables beam steering over larger \n",
    "# angles with narrower beams. This is because the element spacing remains 0.5λ, while the \n",
    "# weights of individual elements can be controlled independently.\n",
    "\n",
    "panelTemplate = AntennaPanel([2,2], polarization=\"x\")\n",
    "txArray = AntennaArray([1,4], panels=panelTemplate)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Here is how the same beams look:\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, layout='constrained', subplot_kw={'projection': 'polar'})\n",
    "txArray.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=10$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txArray.getSteeringVector(90,10).conj().flatten(), ax=ax[0])\n",
    "txArray.drawRadiation(theta=90, radiationType=\"Field\", normalize=False, title = \"$\\\\phi=40$\",\n",
    "                      weights=txArray.getSteeringVector(90,40).conj().flatten(), ax=ax[1])"
   ]
  },
